description: Gradient descent on variational free energy under a Markov decision process model reproduced repetition suppression, mismatch negativity, violation responses, place-cell activity, phase precession, theta sequences, theta-gamma coupling, evidence accumulation, race-to-bound dynamics and the transfer of dopamine responses.
limitations: Simulations show the process theory can reproduce these phenomena, not that the brain implements it.

sources.quote: These include repetition suppression, mismatch negativity, violation responses, place-cell activity, phase precession, theta sequences, theta-gamma coupling, evidence accumulation, race-to-bound dynamics, and transfer of dopamine responses.
